## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: strong sector breadth alongside a concentrated leadership in semiconductors (INTC/AMAT/LRCX/ASML) plus major MegaCap Tech weakness (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL) creates conflicting signals. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology (semiconductors): INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples: TGT (1W: +10.33% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND, KHC (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +7.13%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing strength: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Energy is weakest: XOM (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -2.35%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +1.58%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Technology shows bifurcation with large-cap platforms under pressure: AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND. Communication/Big Tech weakness: GOOGL (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -8.05%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +13.51% | 1M: +17.83%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -10.42% | 1M: +0.29%) TREND EXHAUSTION, NOW (1W: -9.16% | 1M: +17.35%) TREND EXHAUSTION, INTU (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -25.55%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Biggest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +25.61%), AMAT (1W: +25.22%), LRCX (1W: +20.95%), ASML (1W: +13.51%), TGT (1W: +10.33%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among MegaCaps (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META) versus semiconductor strength — tactical uncertainty, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed — semiconductors are driving gains while platform Tech is weak: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND. Overall Tech showing internal rotation despite positive 1W aggregate.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Constructive: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +0.65%) TREND EXHAUSTION, MA (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND — Financials broadly supportive of risk assets but watch idiosyncratic names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Defensive tone with pockets of strength: JNJ (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +1.83%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND — mixed news flow (GILD positive, ISRG under scrutiny) keeps sector watchful.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to the semiconductor axis and selective Financials/Consumer Staples while reducing exposure to mega-cap platform weakness; rotate selectively rather than broad beta increase given CAUTION. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — narrow semiconductor leadership but major-cap divergences warrant selectivity.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -18.86% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Semiconductors/Technology (narrow leadership) and Financials — monitor breadth for broad participation. BEARISH: Energy and platform Communication/Big Tech if MegaCap selling continues.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch whether INTC/AMAT sustain this week’s gaps and hold gains for trend confirmation; monitor AAPL and MSFT for breakdowns below recent monthly support (continued BELOW TREND would increase downside risk); JPM and CAT breakouts above recent highs would confirm cyclical participation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
ASML (+55): ASML (1W: +13.51% | 1M: +17.83%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming widening moat narrative. GOOGL (+50): GOOGL (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND — bullish AI news but price diverging, watch for distribution. CAT (+50): CAT (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND — dividend hike/upgrade sentiment confirmed by modest upside.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
BAC (-65): Bank of America (-65) headline elevates regulatory risk; monitor price action for follow-through (news negative vs. Financials still generally ABOVE TREND via JPM). ISRG (-60): Intuitive Surgical (-60) faces FDA scrutiny — monitor for downside pressure relative to Healthcare peers. AMGN (-60): Amgen (-60) headline on Tavneos adds idiosyncratic risk; watch stock reaction vs. sector peers.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership — strong breadth (10/11 sectors positive) but concentrated semiconductor leadership and MegaCap Tech weakness. Semiconductors showing relative strength: INTC ABOVE TREND, AMAT ABOVE TREND, LRCX ABOVE TREND; Financials/Staples supportive (JPM, TGT ABOVE TREND). Key risk: MAJOR divergence between narrow semis leadership and broad MegaCap Tech weakness, with mixed sentiment (GOOGL bullish news but BELOW TREND) — watch for trend confirmation.
